queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Evernote%' AND publisher = 'Bending Spoons US Inc.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Evernote%' AND publisher = 'Bending Spoons US Inc.' AND version_compare(version, '11.44.6') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'evernote.exe');
